chunks.heading: Who is dual-eligible
chunks.text: Dual-eligible members have both Medicare and Medicaid. They may be enrolled in a dual special needs plan (D-SNP) or a Medicare-Medicaid plan (MMP) that coordinates both benefits under one card.

chunks.heading: Payer order
chunks.text: Medicare pays first and Medicaid pays second for covered services. Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries (QMB) cannot be billed for Medicare deductibles, coinsurance or copays by any provider.

chunks.heading: Balance billing complaints
chunks.text: If a QMB member received a bill for cost sharing, tell the member they are not responsible for it, log a billing complaint in CRM and create a provider education referral so the provider stops billing the member.
